Actual Paystack TEST Initialize compiles in DEV and TEST. Synthetic fixtures remain TEST-only. Production cannot activate either mode. The real integration has a fixed HTTPS origin. Its local seam pins the exact loopback certificate. Fixture credentials, origins, retention and Verify schedules cannot cross into provider scope.

Emit only response classifications and timings. Reject provider dispatch when Finch handlers could capture raw metadata. Keep runtime settings, in-memory request credentials and payload, reference and capability out of inspected values. Disable SQL query telemetry while touching restricted data.

The action rejects explicit outer transactions and reads the exact claim from a different unboxed connection. This also excludes an implicit SQL Sandbox savepoint. The receiver counts actual POSTs independently.

idempotency_retry.summary: Exact replay recovers the original reference. A committed claim remains consumed after a lost response, timeout, error envelope or application restart.
Req uses HTTP/1, disables retries and redirects, bounds pool/connect/receive and best-effort exchange times, and caps the response body at 16 KiB.

failure_recovery.summary: Pre-commit rollback preserves the original prepared reference for its first dispatch. After commitment the claim is ambiguous until applicable evidence is retained, even when the receiver saw no request.
A fresh BEAM recovers the committed capability without another send. An unreadable or missing capability leaves the original claim ambiguous.
The additive schema leaves P1, S1 and E2a rows intact. Rollback holds an exclusive table lock and refuses to erase a retained binding.

safe_extensions.summary: Actual provider operation requires exact WELL-176 owner approval and applicable stage evidence. Bind runtime NEW_YOU_PAYSTACK_TEST_ENABLED, NEW_YOU_PAYSTACK_TEST_APPROVED_ATTEMPT_ID, NEW_YOU_PAYSTACK_TEST_RESTRICTED_KEY, NEW_YOU_PAYSTACK_TEST_EMAIL and NEW_YOU_PAYSTACK_TEST_CAPABILITY_KEY (base64, 32 decoded bytes). Supply secret values privately and preserve the capability key for recovery.

Private DEV invocation uses mise exec -- devcore-project run dev -- iex -S mix (set NEW_YOU_PORT for linked worktrees). Set NEW_YOU_PAYSTACK_DEV_PLAN_APPROVAL in the private process environment as JSON binding one canonical payer_id, operation_id, offer_id, approval_id, disclosure_en_id and disclosure_af_id. With a canonical DEV session held privately, call Privacy.register_development_checkout_subject(credentials), OfferCatalogue.prepare_development_plan(credentials), then OfferAdmission.quote(%{credentials: credentials}, %{product: :plan, language: :en}). After the payer accepts the displayed R399 terms, pass the exact operation_id, quote_id and disclosure_fingerprint to OfferAdmission.accept/2 with the same credentials. Use the returned attempt_id for the separately approved runtime activation. Use HostedCheckout.prepare/3 and then initialize/3 with that exact immutable snapshot and %{provider: :paystack, integration: :voelgoedwinkel, environment: :test, channel: :card}. Access the returned capability only in private local custody. The code emits no provider request during Privacy registration, offer preparation, quote, acceptance or reference preparation.
